data.one_liner: Platform interface for communicating with wearable watch devices
data.what_it_does: Provides a common API for interacting with watches across platforms. Implementations expose methods for sending and receiving data via event channels.
use_when: You need to support multiple watch platforms (WearOS, Apple Watch, Garmin) in a single app
You want a consistent API for watch communication across Flutter projects
avoid_when: You only target a single watch platform and prefer a dedicated plugin
You need full implementation of watch features rather than just an interface
strengths: Uses uuid to identify instances across isolates
EventChannel based for efficient message streaming
weaknesses: No concrete implementation – requires a separate plugin
Limited documentation on specific methods beyond the interface
